changed: context_assembler: shadow (ADR 0032): context.compared and context.shadow_failed event types (ids, counts, digests, estimates, a turn number and an acknowledgement flag); kernel/context_shadow.py builds the pack before every driver turn, run loop and post-write acknowledgement, from real sources (referenced_evidence from proposal.created evidence ids, deferred_pending from pending_action_id, observation turns from events) and records the comparison after the turn; a failure records context.shadow_failed with a stage and changes nothing else. off is byte-identical (goldens unchanged). release_report.py gains context columns, repair rate and token cost; evals/reports/phase3-baseline.json (fixture, off): repair rate 0.4706 (16/34 proposals, 21 cases), model_tokens unknown with the scripted driver. Client schema regenerated (openapi.json, schema.ts) for the two event types; README lists the release-report flag. Review fix: the acknowledgement shadow is built outside the final-response guard (D3-30). Commits b1ddb93, 94b8010, 3dae1aa; reviews harness/state/3/reviews/3d.3.json, 3d.3-r1.json.
open_items: 3f.2: repair_metrics counts every non-PASS validation.completed, including dispatch STALE and later plan steps; tighten before the comparison (D3-31).

ADR 0032: context.failed marks the acknowledgement turn as turn:"acknowledgement" while the shadow events use turn:int plus acknowledgement:bool; reconcile the encodings and record the key sets (D3-33).

3d.4: deferred_pending is pending_action_id; rule_texts is not passed (the kernel cannot reach the rule inventory without importing a plugin), so validator messages stay masked on undeclared hosted routes.
Token cost needs a report built on the replays; the scripted driver reports no tokens. The ledger's driver_turns and model_tokens stay unknown.
The replay consumer sees zero drops under the default policy (D3-32).

rulings.ruling: referenced_evidence is the evidence ids proposal.created bound (ADR 0031 §3), i.e. every observation present at the proposal.
rulings.cost_if_wrong: In on, a broad referenced set can fail assembly with BUDGET_EXCEEDED.

rulings.ruling: Shadow input reads are guarded as stage inputs in both paths, so a shadow failure never suppresses a turn or books a budget event.
rulings.cost_if_wrong: A store failure on the shadow read is recorded rather than surfacing; the turn's own reads still surface it.

outside_repo.change: Postgres test database e_agent_test used by the pg gate.
